deltas.observed: Eyes appear as solid light green color without visible complexity
deltas.target: Light green iris with distinct hazel flecks, subtle limbal ring for depth
deltas.notes: Current 'Light Green With Hazel Flecks' is text-only. Split into atomic visual properties: base color, fleck presence/pattern, and limbal ring intensity. Renderer needs explicit iris components.

deltas.observed: Freckles appear very faint or nearly absent
deltas.target: Moderate to heavy freckle density across cheeks, nose bridge, and shoulders
deltas.notes: Current 'Present, Across Face/Shoulders' lacks visual control. Need density (none/light/medium/heavy), coverage region (cheeks/t-zone/full-face/face-shoulders), and contrast (subtle/visible/prominent) for accurate rendering.

deltas.observed: Skin appears fair but undertone warmth is subtle
deltas.target: Fair skin with distinctly warm/peachy undertones
deltas.notes: Current 'Fair With Warm Undertones' combines tone and undertone. Split for precise control: Tone (fair/medium/tan/deep) + Undertone.Type (cool/neutral/warm/golden-warm) + Undertone.Intensity (subtle/moderate/strong).

deltas.observed: Hair appears as uniform red-auburn without dimensional variation
deltas.target: Red-auburn base with copper highlights and natural color variation
deltas.notes: Current 'Red-Auburn' is monolithic. Hair has base color + highlights/lowlights + dimensional variation. Enable multi-tonal realism.

deltas.observed: Hair shows waves but pattern type unclear (2A vs 2B vs 2C)
deltas.notes: Current 'Wavy' is imprecise. Use curl typing system (1/straight, 2A/2B/2C/wavy, 3A/3B/3C/curly, 4A/4B/4C/coily) + wave definition (loose/medium/defined) for accurate texture.

deltas.observed: Side part visible but consistency/frequency unknown
deltas.target: Highly consistent left side part (appears in 90%+ of images)
deltas.notes: Current 'Side Part, Often Left' is vague. Add Parting.Side (left/right/center/none) + Parting.Consistency (low/medium/high) for behavioral accuracy.

deltas.observed: Eye shape captured but spacing/proportion relative to face missing
deltas.target: Average eye spacing, proportionate to face width
deltas.notes: Shape alone insufficient for facial harmony. Add EyeSpacing (close/average/wide) and EyeSize (small/medium/large) relative to face.

deltas.observed: Facial structure present but cheekbone prominence not specified
deltas.notes: Add facial structure detail: Cheekbones (subtle/moderate/prominent/high-sharp) for facial dimension.

deltas.observed: Smile shape captured but lip fullness/definition missing
deltas.target: Medium-full lips with defined cupid's bow
deltas.notes: Current SmileDNA focuses on smile. Add LipFullness (thin/medium/full/very-full) and CupidsBow (subtle/defined/pronounced) for lip realism.
